## R Markdown
R markdown is a file format for makink more dynamic documents with R rather than just a plain blank doument.R markdown allows you to combine narrative text, coding, and high quality output into one report.
# Narrative Overview
when working with data, documenting the workflowis just as important as getting the results.Using R markdown bridges the gap and allows you to combine them both into one proffesional documentation.

# Load a library or dataset

```{r cars}
library(ggplot2)
data(mtcars)
summary(mtcars[,c ("mpg","wt")])
```

## Run simple analysis

You can also embed plots, for example:



# Plot network using ggplot2

```{r]
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
geom_point(color = "darkblue", size = 3) +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
theme_minimal() +
labs(
title = "Fuel Efficiency vs. Car Weight",
x = "Weight (1,000 lbs)",
y = "Miles Per Gallon (MPG)"
)
```
